sources.title: Marine propeller pitch is the nominal forward distance a propeller would advance in one revolution in a solid medium.
Propeller slip is the difference between that theoretical advance and the distance the boat actually travels, as a percentage of the theoretical advance.
Unit conversions: 1 nautical mile = 1,852 m = 72,913.386 inches; 1 knot = 1.150779 mph = 1.852 km/h.
